mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Hold the designated planet and eliminate the mandated number of bile-producing Terminids in order to prove the safety of our chemical airstrikes, and to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.
mo_brief.translated: 守住指定行星，歼灭规定数量的吐酸终结族，以证明我方化学空袭的安全性，并协助推进一项至关重要、且已周密规划的空载毒性研究。

items.original:
NEW STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE

Automatons are attacking MENKENT and MARFARK, and worse, broadcasting vile lies claiming defensive gas strikes on SENGE 23 harmed Super Earth citizens.

Helldivers: liberate MARFARK, targeted by the Incineration Corps, and MENKENT, targeted by the Jet Brigade to forcibly deny these baseless, unlawful socialist fabrications—and their craven falsehoods.
items.translated:
新战略指令

机器人正在进攻库楼三与玛尔法克，更恶劣的是，他们还在散布恶毒谎言，声称对新戈23的防御性毒气打击伤害了超级地球公民。

绝地潜兵：解放玛尔法克与库楼三。前者正遭炽灼部队攻击，后者正遭喷气旅攻击。以武力彻底否定这些毫无根据、非法的社会主义捏造，以及他们怯懦的谎言。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

The Illuminate have manipulated harmless gaseous residues into somehow affecting exclusive Class A retirement facilities orbiting SENGE 23.

To prove the safety of Eagle Gas Storms—normally entirely benevolent to human lungs—Helldivers must hold SENGE 23, and deploy to the Terminid front to eliminate 30,000,000 Bile Spewers and 40,000,000 Bile Spitters, to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.
items.translated:
新重要指令

光能者将无害的气体残留物加以操控，竟使其影响到环绕新戈23运行的专属A级退休设施。

为证明飞鹰毒气风暴的安全性（通常对人体肺部完全无害），绝地潜兵必须守住新戈23，并部署至终结族前线，消灭 3000 万（30,000,000）只喷酸虫与 4000 万（40,000,000）只吐酸虫，以协助一项至关重要且计划周全的空气毒性研究。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

The liberation of SENGE 23 has concluded with a decisive victory for the Helldivers. High-definition broadcasts of the engagement were successfully transmitted to cheering homes across the Federation, prompting an immediate 4.2% increase in regional real estate futures.

As a routine operational byproduct, harmless gaseous residues are now dispersing into adjacent residential flight corridors. Air quality experts have decisively concluded there is no cause for concern.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

新戈23的解放以绝地潜兵的压倒性胜利告终。交战的高清转播已成功传送至联邦各地欢呼的千家万户，区域房地产期货随即上涨 4.2%。

作为例行行动的副产品，无害的气体残留物目前正扩散至邻近的居民飞行走廊。空气质量专家已果断判定：无需担忧。

items.original:
DSS MAINTENANCE UPDATE

Unforeseable supply line disruptions are preventing Helldiver contributions to DSS Tactical Actions from being received. The issue is currently being addressed and will be resolved in an appropriately expedient manner unworthy of complaint. 

Personnel are advised to avoid contribution to the DSS and undue contemplation or communication about this issue until normal operation is restored. Violations will be appropriately logged in the violator's permanent files.
items.translated:
民主空间站维护更新

不可预见的补给线中断，正导致绝地潜兵对民主空间站战术行动的贡献无法送达。问题已在处理中，并将以适当且迅速、不容抱怨的方式解决。

建议全体人员暂停对民主空间站的贡献，并在恢复正常运作前，避免对此事过度思考或传播。违规行为将适当记录在违规者的永久档案中。

items.original: TERREK is under attack by the Terminids! All Helldivers must deploy immediately to defend it!
items.translated: 泰雷克正遭受终结族攻击！全体绝地潜兵必须立即部署，保卫泰雷克！

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Shattered Illuminate divisions are consolidating on SENGE 23. High Command has authorized a live broadcast of their imminent eradication to every loyal home.

To bolster this initative, the recently restored DSS (Democracy Space Station) has deployed, newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm to enable widespread chemical peacekeeping.

Liberate SENGE 23 and eliminate 400,000,000 Illuminate hostiles.
items.translated:
新重大指令

光能者残部正在新戈23重整旗鼓。最高指挥部已批准，将这场即将到来的歼灭行动向所有忠诚的家园进行实况转播。

为壮大此役声势，近日修复完毕的民主空间站已部署就位，并新装飞鹰毒气风暴，以便开展大范围化学维和。

解放新戈23，歼灭 4 亿（400,000,000）光能者敌军。

items.original:
DSS MAINTENANCE UPDATE

The Democracy Space Station has been offline for recalibration. Engineers have been altering the functionality of the Eagle Storm Tactical Action, in collaboration with C.O.B. Genetics, to deploy aerosol-based deterrents.

The DSS has been returned to operational service.
items.translated:
民主空间站维护更新

民主空间站此前离线，进行重新校准。工程人员与 C.O.B. 遗传学部门合作，改造了飞鹰风暴战术行动的功能，用以投放气溶胶类威慑剂。

民主空间站现已恢复服役。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Buoyed by inspiring footage of the Federation's greatest heroes decimating its greatest enemies, Maelstrom Tank sales to the public have skyrocketed. Citizens are clamoring for the opportunity to defend their homes and families with their very own Tank. 

The Maelstrom Tank is available for Helldiver use in perpetuity.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

联邦最伟大的英雄们歼灭最凶恶敌人的英姿鼓舞人心，受此激励，风暴漩涡坦克的民用销量一路飙升。公民们纷纷请愿，渴望拥有属于自己的坦克，亲手保卫家园与家人。

风暴漩涡坦克现已永久供绝地潜兵使用。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Unrelenting enemy aggression has put production of the Maelstrom Tank in jeopardy. To recoup costs, the Helldivers are ordered to aid the creation of a public awareness sales campaign. Footage of the Helldivers obliterating Freedom's enemies could increase pre-sales, providing the funding needed to save the project.

GATRIA and WASAT have just come under attack. Deploy to defend these planets, utilizing the Maelstrom Tank.
items.translated:
新重要指令

敌军攻势步步紧逼，风暴漩涡坦克的生产已岌岌可危。为挽回成本，绝地潜兵奉命协助打造一场面向公众的宣传销售活动。潜兵歼灭自由之敌的影像有望提振预售，为挽救该项目提供所需资金。

盖尔崔亚与天樽二刚刚遭到进攻。即刻部署，保卫这两颗行星，并投入使用风暴漩涡坦克。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER FAILED

Insufficient materials have been harvested by the Helldivers to fulfill production quotas for deluxe Maelstrom Tank features. This has caused significant distress amongst the early investors who were promised these features as incentives, resulting in a precipitous drop in pre-sales and a decrease in share value.

As a result, the Maelstrom Tank project is now at risk of termination.
items.translated:
重要指令失败

绝地潜兵采集到的材料不足，无法满足“风暴漩涡”坦克豪华配置的生产配额。当初向早期投资者承诺这些配置作为激励，如今承诺落空，投资者极度不满，预售量骤降，股价随之下跌。

因此，“风暴漩涡”坦克项目如今面临终止风险。
